title: Wednesday · listen, learn and choose
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in forms and get your work ready.
note: Listen to Nevermoor before the 9:15 workshop. Begin fractions after recess if time allows. Keep the afternoon flexible for current SpacesEDU work, Werewolf or another teacher-selected option, around regular in-class support (1:05–1:30) and Health/Career (1:35–2:10). No new assignment or deadline is added.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in forms.
Check today’s plan and choose your first useful task.

blocks.title: Language Arts · Nevermoor
studentSteps: Listen for an important event or character choice.
Be ready to share a detail you noticed.
blocks.notes: Stop in time to be ready for the workshop. Use the actual audiobook stopping point; do not assume a chapter.

blocks.title: Racial-equity workshop
blocks.firstAction: Get ready to listen and take part respectfully.
studentSteps: Listen thoughtfully and respect different experiences.
blocks.notes: Replaces the usual morning Werewolf block.

blocks.title: Transition
blocks.firstAction: Return to our classroom routine and get ready for snack.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Mathematics · fractions, if time allows
blocks.firstAction: Get your math materials ready when directed.
studentSteps: Begin or continue the fractions work selected by your teacher.
Use a visual model and explain your thinking.
Try the selected practice at a pace that helps you understand.
blocks.notes: Start fractions if time allows. Continue from what has actually been taught; do not assume mixed numbers or comparison work is complete. Math Antics can support the lesson; use board models with equal-sized wholes if video is unavailable.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: Learning choices and current work
blocks.firstAction: Listen for the afternoon plan before choosing your task.
studentSteps: Finish or improve current SpacesEDU work when directed.
We may choose Werewolf or another class activity if time allows.
Save your work and organize what you need for tomorrow.
blocks.notes: Keep activity lengths and choices flexible around regular in-class support 1:05–1:30 and Health/Career 1:35–2:10. Do not promise a game or assume devices are booked.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.

backups: Keep snack, recess, lunch and dismissal at their usual times.
If fractions cannot begin after recess, continue at the next available lesson without treating the planned work as completed.
If devices are unavailable, prepare posting text or evidence on paper.
